item.title: ‘Godzilla’ El Niño May Slash Malaysia’s Rice Output
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Extreme weather projections could slash local rice production from ~40% contribution in key granary states to as low as 20%, says a KPKM official. Malaysia only produces 52% of its rice needs, leaving it exposed if exporting countries restrict supply. The post ‘Godzilla’ El Niño May Slash Malaysia’s Rice Output appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Sustainability Of Primary Care Supersedes Doctors’ Income: FPMPAM
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
FPMPAM says MMA's survey about GP clinics appears to refer to clinic business revenue, rather than doctors' personal income, adding that the bigger issue is about the sustainability of Malaysia's community-based primary care system, not doctors' earnings. item.title: MOH Issuing New Circular On Junior Medical Officers’ Working Hours
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Dr Dzul says the Health DG will issue a new circular on junior medical officers' working hours, besides stressing compliance with flexi-work guidelines for housemen. Junior doctors in Malaysia work 65 to 85 hours weekly, far higher than the UK's 40 hours. The post MOH Issuing New Circular On Junior Medical Officers’ Working Hours appeared first on CodeBlue .
